statuses.candidate: Potential source; specific endpoint or availability unverified.

safety_and_quality_rules: Do not equate absence of a record with compliance.
Distinguish property owner, operator, licensee, health system and manager.
Preserve source record ID, original text, event date, observation date, source URL, coverage and match confidence.
Do not infer equipment installation or service need as confirmed from a generic deficiency.
Do not bypass access controls; check commercial reuse conditions.
No patient-level data; minimize personal identifiers.
Do not modify TowerSignal production as part of this research.
